title: 缓存回填与一致性
focus: 删除与更新缓存的局部取舍
scenarioConstraints: 数据库初值为 v1，缓存初始不存在该 key；写入 v2 后提交
读请求先读到 v1，写请求提交后删除缓存，读请求再回填 v1

en.title: Cache Refill and Consistency
focus: Local trade-offs of deleting vs updating cache
scenarioConstraints: Database initially contains v1 and the cache key is absent; a writer commits v2
A reader fetches v1, the writer commits and deletes the cache, then the reader caches v1

title: 缓存过期与请求合并
focus: 同一 key 并发 miss
scenarioConstraints: 单进程内两个线程同时读取一个已过期的 key
缓存未命中时调用同一个慢速数据库查询

en.title: Cache Expiry and Request Coalescing
scenarioConstraints: Two threads in one process read the same expired key
Each cache miss invokes the same slow database query

title: 幂等键与重试结果
scenarioConstraints: 同一订单的两个请求使用相同幂等键
业务更新与幂等记录写入同一个数据库事务

en.title: Idempotency Keys and Retry Outcomes
scenarioConstraints: Two requests for one order share an idempotency key
The business update and idempotency record use one database transaction

title: 消费确认与重复消息
focus: 业务提交后的崩溃窗口
scenarioConstraints: 队列使用手动 ack，未确认的消息会重新投递
消费者已提交数据库事务，但在 ack 前崩溃

en.title: Acknowledgements and Duplicate Messages
scenarioConstraints: The queue uses manual acknowledgements and redelivers unacknowledged messages
A consumer commits its database transaction, then crashes before acknowledging

title: 分区顺序与消费并发
scenarioConstraints: Kafka 同一分区依次包含同一订单的创建与取消事件
消费者按顺序拉取后交给两个工作线程处理

en.title: Partition Ordering and Consumer Concurrency
scenarioConstraints: One Kafka partition contains create then cancel events for the same order
A consumer fetches in order, then dispatches to two worker threads

title: 令牌桶与突发请求
scenarioConstraints: 单进程令牌桶容量为 5，初始满桶，每秒补充 1 个令牌
同一时刻有 8 个请求，每个请求消耗 1 个令牌，令牌不足立即拒绝

en.title: Token Buckets and Bursts
scenarioConstraints: A single-process token bucket starts full with capacity 5 and refills one token per second
Eight simultaneous requests each require one token; insufficient tokens cause immediate rejection

title: 库存扣减与事务并发
focus: 条件更新与受影响行数
scenarioConstraints: PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED，库存初值为 1
两个事务分别 SELECT 库存，在应用内减一，再写回计算值

en.title: Inventory Updates and Transaction Concurrency
scenarioConstraints: PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED with initial stock 1
Two transactions each SELECT stock, subtract one in application code, then write back the computed value

title: 异步复制与读己之写
scenarioConstraints: 主库提交成功不等待异步副本应用日志
用户更新昵称成功后，立即从只读副本查询昵称

en.title: Asynchronous Replication and Read-Your-Writes
focus: Cost of temporarily reading from the primary
scenarioConstraints: Primary commit acknowledgement does not wait for an asynchronous replica to apply the log
A user updates a nickname successfully, then immediately reads it from the replica

title: 哈希取模与键迁移
focus: 一致性哈希的基本边界
scenarioConstraints: 路由规则为 hash(key) % N，hash 输出为非负整数
节点数从 3 改为 4，观察 hash 值为 5 的 key

en.title: Hash Modulo and Key Remapping
scenarioConstraints: Routing uses hash(key) % N with nonnegative integer hashes
Node count changes from 3 to 4; inspect a key whose hash is 5

title: RPC 超时与重试放大
focus: 超时与服务端执行状态
scenarioConstraints: 调用链 A → B → C，每层失败后最多额外重试 2 次
C 持续超时；客户端超时不会自动撤销 C 已开始的操作

en.title: RPC Timeouts and Retry Amplification
scenarioConstraints: Call chain A → B → C; each layer allows at most two additional retries
C keeps timing out; a client timeout does not automatically undo work already started at C

title: 事务快照与重复读取
scenarioConstraints: PostgreSQL 18 READ COMMITTED；T1 首次 SELECT 余额为 100
T2 将余额更新为 80 并提交，随后 T1 在同一事务中再次普通 SELECT；无其他写入

en.title: Transaction Snapshots and Repeated Reads
scenarioConstraints: PostgreSQL 18 READ COMMITTED; T1 first SELECTs a balance of 100
T2 updates the balance to 80 and commits; T1 then performs another plain SELECT in the same transaction; no other writes

title: 联合索引与扫描范围
scenarioConstraints: PostgreSQL 18 表 orders 的 B-tree 索引为 (tenant_id, created_at)
查询 WHERE tenant_id = 7 AND created_at >= 指定时间；只分析该索引可缩小的扫描范围，不预设优化器必选它

en.title: Composite Indexes and Scan Ranges
scenarioConstraints: PostgreSQL 18 orders has a B-tree index on (tenant_id, created_at)
Query WHERE tenant_id = 7 AND created_at >= a given timestamp; examine the index scan range without assuming the planner must choose it

title: 覆盖索引与可见性检查
scenarioConstraints: PostgreSQL 18 索引为 ON users(id) INCLUDE (name)，查询 SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = 7
计划使用 Index Only Scan，但目标堆页的 all-visible 位未设置

en.title: Covering Indexes and Visibility Checks
scenarioConstraints: PostgreSQL 18 index ON users(id) INCLUDE (name); query SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = 7
The plan uses Index Only Scan, but the target heap page has no all-visible bit set

title: 行锁顺序与死锁
scenarioConstraints: PostgreSQL 18 中 T1 已更新行 A，T2 已更新行 B，均未提交
T1 随后更新 B，T2 随后更新 A；两行不同，无其他事务

en.title: Row Lock Ordering and Deadlocks
scenarioConstraints: In PostgreSQL 18, T1 has updated row A and T2 row B; neither has committed
T1 next updates B and T2 next updates A; the rows are distinct and no other transactions exist

title: 分页偏移与并发插入
scenarioConstraints: 按不可变且唯一的 id 升序分页，已读取 id 10、20 的第一页，每页 2 行
下一次查询前插入 id 15；第二页使用 ORDER BY id LIMIT 2 OFFSET 2，两次查询采用独立快照

en.title: Offset Pagination and Concurrent Inserts
scenarioConstraints: Paginate by immutable unique id ascending; page one returned ids 10 and 20 with page size 2
Insert id 15 before fetching page two using ORDER BY id LIMIT 2 OFFSET 2; each query has a separate snapshot

title: 事务回滚与序列空洞
focus: 序列与事务数据的边界
唯一编号不等于连续编号
scenarioConstraints: PostgreSQL 18 表使用序列生成主键，事务 T1 获取序列值 42 后回滚
随后 T2 获取同一序列的下一个值；无并发调用、重置或序列缓存丢失

en.title: Transaction Rollback and Sequence Gaps
scenarioConstraints: A PostgreSQL 18 table uses a sequence for primary keys; T1 obtains sequence value 42 and rolls back
T2 then obtains the next value from that sequence; there are no concurrent calls, resets or lost sequence caches

title: TCP 字节流与消息边界
scenarioConstraints: 客户端在同一 TCP 连接上依次 send 两条消息，每条均为 4 字节长度前缀加消息体
服务端使用普通 recv，每次缓冲区最多 1024 字节；无应用层分隔符或其他协议

en.title: TCP Byte Streams and Message Framing
scenarioConstraints: A client sends two messages over one TCP connection, each with a four-byte length prefix followed by a body
The server uses ordinary recv with a buffer of at most 1024 bytes; there are no delimiters or other protocols

title: TCP 半关闭与 EOF
focus: 协议完成与连接资源释放
scenarioConstraints: Linux 上客户端发完请求后 shutdown(SHUT_WR)，仍保持读方向开启
服务端读完全部请求字节后 recv 返回 0，尚未发送响应；无 RST 或网络错误

en.title: TCP Half-Close and EOF
scenarioConstraints: On Linux a client sends its request then calls shutdown(SHUT_WR), keeping its read direction open
After consuming all request bytes, server recv returns zero before the response is sent; no RST or network error occurs

title: HTTP 条件请求与 304
scenarioConstraints: 客户端已缓存 GET /profile 的响应体和 ETag "v1"，缓存现已过期
再次 GET 携带 If-None-Match: "v1"；源站表示未改变并返回 304，无响应体

en.title: HTTP Conditional Requests and 304
focus: 304 and reuse of a stored body
scenarioConstraints: A client cached a GET /profile body with ETag "v1"; that cached response is now stale
A new GET carries If-None-Match: "v1"; the origin reports no change with a bodyless 304 response

title: HTTP no-cache 与 no-store
scenarioConstraints: 浏览器收到 Cache-Control: no-cache 和 ETag 的可缓存 GET 响应；无其他缓存限制
用户随后再次请求同一资源，网络可用；只分析浏览器私有缓存，不涉及共享代理

en.title: HTTP no-cache and no-store
scenarioConstraints: A browser receives an otherwise cacheable GET response with Cache-Control: no-cache and an ETag; no other caching restrictions apply
The user requests the same resource again with network available; consider only the browser private cache, not shared proxies

title: TLS 加密与服务端身份
focus: 主机名与证书身份匹配
scenarioConstraints: HTTPS 客户端连接 api.example.com，服务端证书链受信任，但证书只包含 other.example.com 的身份
无代理、自定义信任策略或其他匹配名称；客户端拟通过关闭主机名校验解决连接错误

en.title: TLS Encryption and Server Identity
scenarioConstraints: An HTTPS client connects to api.example.com; the certificate chain is trusted but its only identity is other.example.com
There is no proxy, custom trust policy or other matching name; the client proposes disabling hostname verification to resolve the error

title: 文件描述符与共享偏移
focus: 描述符与打开文件描述
scenarioConstraints: Linux 上 open 普通文件内容 abcdef，得到 fd1，再用 dup(fd1) 得到 fd2
依次 read(fd1, 2) 与 read(fd2, 2)；初始偏移为 0，无并发、seek 或其他读取

en.title: File Descriptors and Shared Offsets
scenarioConstraints: On Linux open a regular file containing abcdef as fd1, then obtain fd2 with dup(fd1)
Sequentially read two bytes from fd1 then two from fd2; initial offset is zero with no concurrent access, seeks or other reads

title: 删除文件与磁盘占用
focus: 目录项与 inode 生命周期
scenarioConstraints: Linux 本地文件系统上，一个日志文件仅有一个硬链接，进程仍持有它的打开描述符
管理员 unlink 该路径后目录中已看不到文件，但描述符仍未关闭；无其他链接或映射

en.title: Unlinking Open Files and Disk Usage
scenarioConstraints: On a local Linux filesystem a log file has one hard link and a process still holds its open descriptor
After unlink removes the path, the file is absent from the directory but its descriptor remains open; no other links or mappings exist

title: epoll 边缘触发与未读数据
focus: 就绪通知不是完整请求
scenarioConstraints: Linux 非阻塞管道读端注册 EPOLLIN | EPOLLET，写端一次写入 100 字节后保持开启且不再写入
读端收到通知后只读 10 字节，再次 epoll_wait；无其他读取者、关闭或错误事件

en.title: Edge-Triggered epoll and Unread Data
focus: Readiness is not a complete request
scenarioConstraints: A nonblocking Linux pipe read end uses EPOLLIN | EPOLLET; its writer writes 100 bytes once and stays open without further writes
After receiving readiness the reader consumes only ten bytes and calls epoll_wait again; there are no other readers, closes or error events

title: volatile 可见性与计数原子性
focus: 可见性与原子性的区别
scenarioConstraints: Java 21 中 volatile int count = 0，两个线程分别执行一次 count++
主线程 start 两个线程并 join 后读取 count；无其他写入或同步保护

en.title: volatile Visibility and Counter Atomicity
scenarioConstraints: In Java 21, volatile int count = 0 and two threads each execute count++ once
The main thread starts both, joins them and reads count; no other writes or synchronization protect the increments

title: 安全发布与 happens-before
focus: 发布后继续修改的边界
scenarioConstraints: Java 21 共享普通字段 data 初值为 0，volatile boolean ready 初值为 false
写线程依次 data = 42、ready = true；读线程读 ready 为 true 后读取 data；发布后无其他修改

en.title: Safe Publication and Happens-Before
scenarioConstraints: In Java 21 shared ordinary field data starts at zero and volatile boolean ready starts false
The writer sets data = 42 then ready = true; the reader observes ready true then reads data; no mutations follow publication

title: 条件等待与唤醒后重检
focus: 监视器与 wait 释放锁
scenarioConstraints: Java 21 消费者在 synchronized(lock) 内用 if (queue.isEmpty()) lock.wait()，随后 remove；生产者使用同一锁并 notifyAll
有两个消费者等待，生产者只加入一个元素；被唤醒线程需重新竞争同一监视器

en.title: Condition Waiting and Predicate Rechecks
focus: Monitors and releasing locks in wait
Rechecking predicates in a while loop
scenarioConstraints: A Java 21 consumer uses if (queue.isEmpty()) lock.wait() then remove inside synchronized(lock); the producer uses the same lock and notifyAll
Two consumers are waiting and the producer adds only one item; awakened threads must compete for the same monitor again

title: 线程池中的嵌套等待
scenarioConstraints: Java 21 ThreadPoolExecutor 固定为 2 个工作线程，使用无界队列且不启用超时
两个正在运行的父任务各向同一池提交一个子任务，并调用 Future.get 无限等待；子任务本身可立即完成

en.title: Nested Waiting in Thread Pools
scenarioConstraints: A Java 21 ThreadPoolExecutor has exactly two workers, an unbounded queue and no timeouts
Both running parent tasks submit a child to that same pool then wait indefinitely in Future.get; each child could finish immediately if scheduled

title: CAS 与 ABA 变化
focus: 版本戳与引用一起比较
scenarioConstraints: Java 21 AtomicReference 初值指向对象 A；T1 读取 A 后暂停，期间对象均保持存活
T2 将引用从 A 改为 B 再改回同一个 A；T1 恢复后 compareAndSet(A, C)；无后续写入

en.title: CAS and ABA Changes
focus: Comparing a stamp with a reference
scenarioConstraints: A Java 21 AtomicReference initially holds object A; T1 reads A then pauses, and all objects remain alive
T2 changes the reference A to B then back to the identical A; T1 resumes with compareAndSet(A, C); no later writes occur

title: JavaScript 微任务与定时器
focus: 定时器不是精确执行时刻
scenarioConstraints: 浏览器同一脚本依次执行 console.log("A")、setTimeout(() => console.log("B"), 0)、Promise.resolve().then(() => console.log("C"))、console.log("D")
无其他任务或异常；只比较这四条输出顺序，不推断实际毫秒延迟，也不涉及 Node.js

en.title: JavaScript Microtasks and Timers
focus: Timers do not specify exact execution times
scenarioConstraints: One browser script executes console.log("A"), setTimeout(() => console.log("B"), 0), Promise.resolve().then(() => console.log("C")), then console.log("D")
There are no other tasks or exceptions; compare only these four logs, not actual millisecond delays or Node.js behavior

title: HashMap 可变键与查找失败
scenarioConstraints: Java 21 HashMap 的键 User 以可变 id 字段实现 equals 与 hashCode；插入时 id = 1
随后同一对象 id 改为 2；两次 hashCode 不同，且没有重插入、扩容或并发操作，再用该对象 get

en.title: Mutable HashMap Keys and Failed Lookups
scenarioConstraints: A Java 21 HashMap key User implements equals and hashCode using mutable id; it is inserted with id = 1
The same object changes id to 2 with a different hashCode; get uses that object without reinsertion, resizing or concurrent operations

title: 异常路径与资源关闭
focus: 主异常与 suppressed 异常
确定性关闭与垃圾回收
scenarioConstraints: Java 21 try-with-resources 成功创建一个 AutoCloseable 资源，try 主体抛出异常 E1
该资源 close() 也抛出异常 E2；无其他资源、catch、finally 或异常包装

en.title: Exception Paths and Resource Cleanup
scenarioConstraints: Java 21 try-with-resources successfully creates one AutoCloseable resource and its body throws E1
That resource close() also throws E2; there are no other resources, catch/finally blocks or exception wrappers

title: Redis Pipeline 与命令原子性
scenarioConstraints: 单个 Redis 实例中客户端 A 用普通 Pipeline 发送 SET x 1 与 GET x，不使用 MULTI 或 Lua
客户端 B 也可执行 SET x 2；各连接内命令保持顺序，但不假定跨连接调度顺序

en.title: Redis Pipelining and Command Atomicity
scenarioConstraints: On one Redis instance client A pipelines SET x 1 and GET x without MULTI or Lua
Client B may execute SET x 2; command order is preserved within each connection with no assumed scheduling order across connections

title: 锁租约过期与旧持有者
focus: 租约无法撤销已开始的操作
scenarioConstraints: 单个 Redis 实例中 A 通过 SET lock tokenA NX PX 1000 获取锁，随后暂停超过 1 秒
租约到期后 B 以 tokenB 获取同名锁；A 恢复后打算直接 DEL lock；无 Redis 故障或时钟跳变

en.title: Lock Lease Expiry and Stale Owners
scenarioConstraints: On one Redis instance A acquires a lock with SET lock tokenA NX PX 1000 then pauses for over one second
After expiry B acquires the same lock with tokenB; A resumes intending to DEL lock directly; no Redis failure or clock jump occurs

title: Redis 过期与内存淘汰
focus: TTL 与淘汰是不同机制
缓存数据不可作为唯一事实
scenarioConstraints: Redis 配置 maxmemory 并采用 allkeys-lru；key K 没有 TTL，且近期很少被访问
新增写入触发内存淘汰；无显式删除、重启或过期操作

en.title: Redis Expiration and Memory Eviction
scenarioConstraints: Redis uses maxmemory with allkeys-lru; key K has no TTL and has rarely been accessed recently
New writes trigger memory eviction; there are no explicit deletes, restarts or expiration operations

title: SQL 参数与查询结构
focus: 数据与 SQL 语法分离
动态标识符的允许列表
scenarioConstraints: Java JDBC 用 PreparedStatement 执行 SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ?，输入通过 setString 绑定
用户输入包含引号和 SQL 片段；不拼接输入，也不进行动态表名、列名或排序字段替换

en.title: SQL Parameters and Query Structure
scenarioConstraints: Java JDBC uses PreparedStatement for SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ? with setString binding
Input contains quotes and SQL fragments; there is no input concatenation or dynamic substitution of table, column or sort identifiers

title: CORS 与跨站请求伪造
focus: 发送请求与读取响应的区别
scenarioConstraints: 受害者登录站点使用 Secure; SameSite=None 会话 Cookie；跨站 Cookie 未被浏览器策略阻止
攻击站点用 HTML form 发起 application/x-www-form-urlencoded POST 修改昵称；服务端无 CSRF 令牌或来源检查，也不允许跨站读取响应

en.title: CORS and Cross-Site Request Forgery
scenarioConstraints: The victim site uses a Secure; SameSite=None session cookie; browser policy does not block cross-site cookies
An attacker submits an HTML form POST with application/x-www-form-urlencoded to change a nickname; the server has no CSRF token or origin check and does not permit cross-origin response reads

title: SQL NULL 与三值逻辑
scenarioConstraints: PostgreSQL 18 users 表只有两行，age 分别为 NULL 和 20
查询 SELECT age FROM users WHERE age <> 18；无其他条件或类型转换

en.title: SQL NULL and Three-Valued Logic
scenarioConstraints: A PostgreSQL 18 users table has only two rows, with age NULL and 20
Query SELECT age FROM users WHERE age <> 18; there are no other predicates or casts

title: fork 与进程内存隔离
scenarioConstraints: Linux 单线程父进程的普通私有堆变量 x = 1，随后 fork 成功
子进程将自己的 x 改为 2 后退出；父进程 waitpid 后读取 x；无共享内存或其他写入

en.title: fork and Process Memory Isolation
scenarioConstraints: A single-threaded Linux parent has ordinary private heap variable x = 1 and successfully forks
The child sets its x to 2 then exits; the parent reads x after waitpid; there is no shared memory or other writer

title: 异步函数的异常传播
focus: 同步 catch 与异步拒绝
scenarioConstraints: 浏览器 JavaScript 中 async function f() { throw new Error("E"); }
调用代码为 try { f(); console.log("after"); } catch { console.log("caught"); }；不 await 或附加 catch，也无其他错误处理

en.title: Exception Propagation in Async Functions
scenarioConstraints: In browser JavaScript, async function f() { throw new Error("E"); }
Caller executes try { f(); console.log("after"); } catch { console.log("caught"); }; it neither awaits nor attaches catch, with no other error handling
